name: tweeter
description: Local Twitter/X terminal UI powered by Bun and TypeScript

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist --entry-naming=cli.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.install:local: bun run build:bin && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && install -m 755 dist/tweeter "$HOME/.local/bin/tweeter" && echo "installed $HOME/.local/bin/tweeter"
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
